content: Enibodi hu sabi ebrijing en laigim len mowa, wal wen pipul dalim im wanim rong, wal im garra gudbinji, bat if im dum samting rong im rili siliwan if im nomo laigim det sambodi hu dalimbat im wanim imbin dum rong.
Wal YAWEI det trubala God im brabli gudbinji langa gudbala pipul, bat im garra panishim detlot pipul hu oldei meigimbat plen blanga dum ola nogudwan ting.
Detlot pipul hu oldei dumbat ola nogudwan ting kaan jidan gudbalawei, bat detlot pipul hu oldei dum gudbala ting garra jidan gudwei en brabli strongbala.
Det gel hu jidan brabli gudwei meigim im hasbin brabli gudbinji, bat det gel hu nomo jidan gudwei meigim im hasbin brabli nogudbinji en im jis laik det nogudwan siknis weya kamat langa boun.
Detlot gudbala pipul oldei gibit feyago langa najalot pipul, bat detlot wikitwan pipul oldei meigimbat plen blanga trikimbat pipul.
Detlot wikitwan pipul oldei tok blanga kilimbat pipul, bat detlot wed blanga ola gudwan pipul oldei seibum detlot pipul hu abumbat trabul.
Ol detlot wikitwan pipul oldei daidaibat en dei nomo libum eni femili biyain, bat detlot gudbala men femili kipgon jidanbat laibala.

If yu garram gudwan main en jinggabat blanga dumbat ola gudwan ting, wal pipul garra tok gudbala wed blanga yu, bat det men hu oldei jinggabat en dumbat ola nogudwan ting, wal nobodi kaan rispek langa im.
Im mobeda blanga jidan wekinmen en abum loda daga den jidan laiga haibala men en nomo garram eni daga.
Detlot gudbala pipul oldei lukaftumbat olabat enimulmob gudwei, bat detlot wikitwan pipul oldei dumbat krulbala ting langa olabat enimulmob.
Detlot pipul hu oldei wekwekbat langa olabat fam garra abum bigismob daga, bat detlot pipul hu oldei drimdrimbat blanga olkain ting, olabat siliwan langa olabat main.
Detlot nogudbala pipul oldei wandim dumbat ola nogud ting, bat detlot gudbala pipul oldei wandim dumbat ola gudbala ting blanga jidan strongbala.
Detlot nogudwan pipul oldei trepam miselp garram olabat ronwan nogudbala wed, bat ola pipul hu jidan trubalawei oldei deigimat miselp brom eni trabul.
If enibodi dumbat gudbala ting im garra gedim gudbala prais, bat if enibodi dumbat nogudbala ting im garra abum panishmen.
Detlot silibala pipul oldei reken olabat oldei dumbat ola rait ting, bat detlot sabibala pipul oldei lisin langa ola gudbala wed blanga enibodi.
Wen det silibala men jidan apset, im dalim ebribodi kwikbalawei garram im ekshan, bat pipul hu garram gudbala main nomo teiknodis langa nogudbala wed.
Wen yu tok trubalawan wed blanga enijing, yu meigim ebrijing jidan gudwei, bat wen yu dalimbat laiyawan wed, yu meigim ebrijing go nogudwan.
Wen yu tok nogudbalawei, wal im ardim yu jis laik bigwan naif kadim yu, bat wen yu tok gudbala wed wal im album yu en meigim yu fil gudwan.
Det trubala wed garra jidan olagijawan, bat det laiyawan wed garra binij kwikbala.
Detlot pipul hu oldei meigimbat nogudwan plen garra hatjamp wen olabat garra sabi wanim garra hepin langa olabat bambai, bat detlot pipul hu oldei meigimbat gudwan plen garra jidan brabli hepi.
Nomo enijing kaan ardim detlot gudbala men, bat detlot nogudwan men garra abumbat loda trabul.
Wal YAWEI nomo laigim detlot pipul hu oldei dalimbat laiya, bat im oldei gudbinji langa detlot pipul hu oldei kipum detlot wed wen dei meigim pramis.
Detlot sabibala pipul nomo toktok blanga wanim olabat sabi, bat detlot nogudbala pipul oldei shoumbat ola nogudwan ting dei oldei dumbat.
Detlot pipul hu dumbat adwek garra jidan garram pawa, bat detlot pipul hu jidanbat leisibala garra oldei dumbat rabishwan wek.
Wen yu wori olataim im meigim yu nogudbinji, bat det brabli kainbala wed garra meigim yu gudbinji.
Detlot pipul hu jidan raitwei oldei album olabat fren, bat det wei blanga nogudwan pipul garra meigim olabat dum ola rong ting.
If yu jidan leisiwan en nomo dum eni wek wal yu kaan gedim det ting weya yu wandim, bat if yu dumbat wek yu garra gedim ola gudbala ting weya yu wandim.
Det gudbalawei im deigim yu langa det roud blanga laif, bat det nogudbalawei im deigim yu langa det roud blanga dai.
